# proximity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:proximity`](gmeow-proximity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/proximity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links an entity to a proximity measurement describing its distance or dissimilarity to another entity. The measurement carries the scalar value (via [`observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) → [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md)), the reference frame (via [`hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)), and the target entity (via [`proximityTo`](gmeow-proximityTo.md)). Flat form for the common case; promote to full reified [`Measurement`](../classes/gmeow-Measurement.md) when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:ProximityMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-ProximityMeasurement.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the flat link from an entity to a proximity measurement about its distance/dissimilarity to another.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter — read the reified [`Measurement`](../classes/gmeow-Measurement.md) directly.

### How to use

- Use flat [`gmeow:proximity`](gmeow-proximity.md) for the common case; the measurement still carries [`gmeow:proximityTo`](gmeow-proximityTo.md), the frame, and the result scalar.
